visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair, wearing a yellow short-sleeved shirt over a white top, stands in a brightly lit indoor room. She speaks directly to the camera with expressive facial movements and hand gestures. In the background, a light-colored wooden desk holds several cosmetic product boxes in pink and white. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a green and white product box labeled 'VT REEDLE SHOT 300'. The woman holds the box, pointing to specific text on it, then displays a silver and white pump bottle. She brings her face close to the camera, pointing at her nose and cheek area to demonstrate skin texture. (3) She presents two large square containers, one white and one pink, by Mediheal. She opens the white container using small clear tweezers to lift a square, textured white pad. She then switches to the pink container, demonstrating the application of a thin, translucent pad onto her cheek. (4) The woman holds a pink aerosol can labeled 'FIXX' alongside its matching pink box. She closes her eyes and sprays the product onto her face, showing a fine mist. (5) She holds a small yellow tube of Torriden lip essence and applies it to her lips while looking into the camera. (6) In the final phase, she holds several of the featured products together, gesturing with her hands while concluding her presentation in the same indoor setting.
